runtime: Float32 ONNX BGE + MiniLM; exact cosine + BM25 + RRF + NetworkX
scope: 40 questions x 3 roles x 3 retrieval modes; no generated-answer or judge scores

definitions.ranking: Recall/precision/NDCG@5 and MRR use authorized gold symbol IDs; unavailable gold sets are N/A.
definitions.code_symbol_resolution_precision: Share of returned symbols in the authorized gold set; full context.
definitions.call_path_recall: Coverage of authorized expected-path symbols in the union of returned paths; no order credit.
definitions.execution_path_accuracy: One returned path must contain the authorized gold path in order, allowing intermediate calls.
definitions.citation_groundedness: Not measured by retrieval; actual answer citations and semantic claim grounding require answer evaluation.
definitions.latency: Local benchmark on this machine, including one cold first query; not Vercel p50/p95 or PyTorch equivalence.
